episodes.163345: A strong cold front produced squalls that resulted in gale- to storm-force wind gusts.
episodes.163731: While a cold front extended northeast to southwest across north Florida, convective showers developing over the extreme south mainland of the Florida peninsula moved southeast, produce isolated gale-force wind gusts along the reef offshore Key Largo.
episodes.163759: Deep tropical moisture associated with a mid-upper level disturbance across South FL along with a surface trough between South FL and the Bahamas allowed for widespread showers and thunderstorms with gusty wind, especially along the eastern half of the region and the Atlantic waters. Heavy rainfall caused flooding, at least partially due to already saturated soils from previous heavy rainfall.
episodes.163760: Deep tropical moisture associated with a mid-upper level disturbance across South FL along with a surface trough between South FL and the Bahamas allowed for widespread showers and thunderstorms with gusty wind and heavy rainfall, especially along the eastern half of the region and the Atlantic waters.

events.county: Palm Beach
events.narrative: Various members of the public reported flooding across portions of Palm Beach County due to slow moving showers and thunderstorms pushing through the area. Flooding in West Palm Beach near the intersection of 25th Street and Australian Avenue with water exceeding curbs and crossing sidewalks and flooding just north of Palm Beach Lakes Boulevard and along North Flagler Drive with water exceeding curbs, low profile cars struggling to pass roadways, and roads closed due to water. Rainfall accumulations were around 2 to 3 inches.
